cases.name: captured-sequence-text
cases.source:
def make():
 count=0
 def words(value=' A B '):
  nonlocal count
  count+=1
  return value.lower().split()
 def read():return count
 return words,read
words,read=make()
print(words(),read())
print(words(value=' C '),read())
print(list(map(words,['D E','F'])),read())

cases.name: captured-sequence-protocol-once
captured-live-read-delete
cases.source:
def make():
 value=[]
 def read():return value
 def write(new):
  nonlocal value
  value=new
 def erase():
  nonlocal value
  del value
 return read,write,erase
read,write,erase=make()
a=read()
a.append('first')
write(['second'])
print(a,read())
erase()
try:read()
except NameError:print('missing')
write(a)
print(read() is a,read())

cases.name: captured-sequence-promotion
cases.source:
def make():
 count=(1<<63)-1
 def words(value):
  nonlocal count
  count+=1
  return value.upper()
 def read():return count
 return words,read
words,read=make()
print(words('é'),read())
print(words(value='ß'),read())
